scope: Three non-production visual-variety studies. Existing story, centered opening, overview, alternating timeline, spacing, palette and type remain the baseline. Only chapter artwork is explored.
brief: User requested concept ideas for visual variety after approving the story structure and copy refinements.

concepts.name: Grower's Field Notes
concepts.thesis: A considered mix of crop photographs, small annotations, purpose diagrams and the brand mark. Each chapter gets a visual role of its own.
concepts.benefit: The broadest variety while preserving the warm editorial identity; can evolve as genuine origin photographs become available.
concepts.tradeoff: Needs authentic origin imagery to fully express the first chapter. Current crop photographs illustrate subject matter, not historical events.
chapters: A genuine terrace photograph, framed with one quiet crop note
Paired microgreen and mushroom photographs with crop labels
A simple diagram connecting the crops to a kitchen
The supplied logo presented as the moment the idea gained a name
A produce composition leading towards the catalogue
concepts.motion: 140ms state feedback; 360ms one-time photo-frame and annotation reveal; no image zoom or continuous floating.
concepts.mobile: Photographs remain side by side where readable, with labels below; diagrams and brand frames reflow above their chapter copy.

concepts.name: Living Cultivation
concepts.thesis: Five bespoke scenes derived from Field Notes linework: planters, growing trays, a produce-to-kitchen connection, the brand and a table setting.
concepts.benefit: A distinctive illustrated story with consistent craft and no dependency on origin photography.
concepts.tradeoff: Creates emotional meaning, but cannot provide documentary proof of the growing operation. Bespoke illustration requires more refinement than enlarging icons.
chapters: Terrace planters and a climbing stem
A window, microgreen tray and mushroom cluster
Crops and basket connected to a kitchen
The supplied brand mark framed by cultivation linework
A table setting with crop details
concepts.motion: 360ms line drawing as each scene enters; the timeline connects the scenes. No looping growth animation.
concepts.mobile: Whole scenes scale to their viewBox; labels remain HTML text. Important content never depends on animation.

concepts.name: Harvest Editorial
concepts.thesis: A photographic reading rhythm: an establishing image, a close detail, a composed still life, a brand interlude and a table scene.
concepts.benefit: The most sensory and food-focused direction, using changing image geometry and crop scale rather than more decoration.
concepts.tradeoff: A consistently art-directed photo set is needed. Produce portraits alone cannot tell the founder's personal history.
chapters: A full terrace scene from the actual origin garden
One generous crop detail with a secondary mushroom inset
A wide table photograph or current supplied produce composition
concepts.motion: 360ms restrained opacity reveal; photographs stay still. Gentle chapter transition, no parallax or scroll locking.
concepts.mobile: Replace extreme detail crops with wider focal framing so the crops remain recognizable; keep text outside photography.

imagery_rules.character: Warm-neutral stone and cream; natural green and mushroom tones; soft side light; restrained contrast; preserve food color and texture.
imagery_rules.provenance: Existing public/media files are supplied source assets. Their capture/generation origin is not verified here. They are subject-matter illustrations, not cultivation or founding evidence.
imagery_rules.historical_images: No terrace or founder origin photographs were supplied in the current media inventory. Their slots remain visibly reserved in this review.
imagery_rules.generated_images: No raster images generated for this study. Bespoke schematic SVG scenes are original code compositions extending approved Field Notes geometry.
imagery_rules.responsive: No text baked into images; preserve the focal crop; informative photo alt text and decorative diagrams hidden from assistive technology when explained by copy.
imagery_rules.motion: Existing 140/220/360ms durations; all imagery and copy visible with reduced motion or JavaScript disabled.

pending: User may select, combine, revise or reject concepts. Gallery selections are previews, not approval. Production website is unchanged.
